title: Chapter 111 Chasing And Fleeing
content:
Chapter 111 Chasing And Fleeing

As the two gods and humans reached their respective agreements, the tense atmosphere on the entire battlefield slowly dissipated!

However, all this is not the end, but the beginning of another killing! The supreme divine mansion above the sky disappeared immediately after the agreement was reached!

For God Vogo, being in the whole world is a very great oppression for him, the will of the world and the humanity of the whole world.

He has been unrepressed all the time, he is monitored anytime and anywhere, and he is allowed to be watched by others as if he has been stripped naked, wantonly abused!

This kind of experience is very unacceptable for a demigod who is almost immortal, as long as he does not encounter a very force majeure situation, the immortal demigod!

Therefore, if it is not necessary, they usually wander in the void of the universe, looking for the demiplanes around the main world one after another.

These half-worlds that live by attachment to the main world are ideal raw materials for the kingdom of God for any half-god who wants to become a true god.

After finding one with a little modification, it will be a very strong and unbreakable kingdom of God, enough to house your real body and the soul of your believers, and create an unbreakable foundation!

Therefore, a very complete half-plane with sufficient laws is very tempting even for some true gods. It is not uncommon for some gods to fight for a good half-plane in their long careers. !

And for Woge, who aspires to become a true god, a truly eternal god, finding a good demiplane is his divinity. After becoming a demigod, the main thing and work.

There have always been many explanations for the origin and existence of all the demiplanes, but the most accepted by the public is also the reason for his original birth.

This is the main plane. During the long process of evolution and expansion, there will always be some food that is difficult to digest or too late to digest.

Therefore, in line with the will of the main world of the principle of not wasting, throw these food directly outside your body, and let the energy tide of the entire universe refine it.

If these grains can survive successfully, they will form relatively complete demiplanes.

Then the main world will drag these fattened lambs directly into its own body, thicken its own body, expand its size, and grow slowly.

From birth to maturity, these demiplanes have been corroded by energy tides and various accidental damages, and the number has never been very large. Generally, there are only 100 of them in 1000 years.

However, in addition to the many divine mansions, those who compete for these demi-planes also have the main plane to snatch, and the main plane is more powerful and grabs more.

Usually there are 100 demiplanes, and many gods can snatch only a dozen or even a few of them, which is extremely rare. All the others have been directly collected by the main world, which is stronger and more powerful, and has filled his stomach!

Therefore, God Vogo, who is very competitive, is reluctant to waste any time, wandering desperately in the void of the universe, surrounding the main world, looking for those demiplanes that were born!

How can you look like an exhibitionist? Put everything about yourself in front of the will of the world and humanity, and let them watch!

Leave the world early and continue your search journey!

For Sun Jian, surrendering directly to a god is not too humiliating, because all the gods, what they need is spiritual rule.

But for Sun Jian, what he needs as a mortal is only physical rule, and the two get what they need, and there is no saying that whoever owes who suffers!

Surrender yourself, except for a nihilistic god's mansion, standing high above your head, no one can control yourself in this world!

Even the Wolf patriarch of the Vogo tribe, who tried to receive all his power in vain, did not let his delusion succeed. Instead, he just became an ordinary man who was on the same level as himself in name, but in fact his power was far from his own. Patriarch!

And after the ravages of their own side, the power loss of the entire Vogo tribe is very huge, and it is difficult to maintain the existing places!

But I can accept those small tribes in the rear, and the emperor Zhong Yu, who is also known as Yuguo, his former master, now the army is out, life and death are unpredictable.

I can take advantage of this opportunity to directly occupy hundreds of miles of territory around Luoyang, and recruit nearly 100,000 civilians from the Imperial Kingdom, so that my strength in this world will be greatly increased, and the chance to unify the plains seems not impossible!

However, all of this must be allowed to control the entire army, so that it can be realized slowly!

This army only needs the voice of one person, and that is me, Sun Jian, not the so-called His Majesty the Emperor. Now I want to give those fools a chance to choose, a chance to decide their future destiny!

Just now, I wanted to send someone to gather all the generals to make a team selection, but suddenly found that the supervisor Tian Feng who was around me, and the military adviser Jia Xu in the army disappeared without a trace. Where to go! At the same time, Zhang Liao, Tai Shici and other powerful generals in the army also disappeared.

This discovery couldn't help but make Sun Jian furious. Now there are about 10,000 troops in the army controlled by them, and the remaining 20,000 people are directly deployed by him.

There are still 10,000 people under the command of Lu Bu, his son and daughter, and these 30,000 people are himself, a very trusted force.

I was thinking about taking over the remaining 10,000 people just now, but found that their leader has disappeared, how can I not be angry, the feeling of being played is lingering in my heart!

Hastily summoned many generals and led their deployment to pursue them, trying to stop these out-of-control soldiers and horses, and reassemble them under their own rule!

After a lot of fuss, when Sun Jian was still recruiting soldiers, he discovered that Tian Feng Jiaxu and Zhang Liao, Tai Shici and others had already led the army to leave the camp, heading for the homeland of Yuguo far away.

When he gathered his soldiers and horses and prepared to pursue them, he found that those soldiers were no longer visible at the end of his eyes, but he still did not give up and sent people to chase them down.

In my heart, even if I can't stop them, I have to kill them all, so as not to worry about many people in the rear to resist my strategy!

But after some hunting, although some gains were made and some infantry under Tian Feng's command were stopped, the 5,000 cavalry in Sun Jian's Southwest Route Army were all commanded by Zhang Liao.

At this moment, he gave up the encumbrance of the 5,000 infantry, but it greatly increased his speed, and he left with the military adviser and others far away early. With the remaining infantry under Sun Jian's command, how could his two legs lose weight early? Four legs too!

I can only leave Sun Jian and his party behind, angrily scolding, but there is nothing to do. They can only quickly speed up their strategy actions, so as not to further aggravate the difficulty of their strategy because of the news!

In fact, for people like Tian Feng, when they had 10,000 troops, if they really sent troops to deal with Sun Jian, they would be caught off guard.

Relying on Zhong Yu's prestige among those soldiers, it is not impossible to regain military power.

But because of the possibility of God's mansion going back and forth, after being angered again, he directly raged and crushed himself, mortals, like ants.

I still gave up this very tempting idea, chose to escape directly, and even came to the rear to gain more time for preparation and defense in order to escape quickly.

Even the 5,000 pawns under his control gave up directly, just asking for more strategic time to prepare!
